title: The Happy Ending Problem (Erdős–Szekeres Conjecture)
statement_plain: Let ES(n) be the smallest integer N such that any N points in the plane in general position (no three collinear) contain the vertices of a convex n-gon. The Erdős–Szekeres conjecture asserts that ES(n) = 2^{n-2} + 1 for every n >= 3.
